[[File:Logray-RotJAVA.png|thumb|150px|[[Logray/Legends|Logray]] with a churi skull on his head.]]
The '''churis''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Bird/Legends|birds]] that was native to [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. The [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Shaman/Legends|shaman]] [[Logray/Legends|Logray]] wore a churi skull atop his head. Logray also had a different churi skull affixed to his hut's roof during the [[Towani family|Towani children's]] [[Caravan of Courage: An Ewok Adventure|search for their parents]].

==Behind the scenes==
In ''Caravan of Courage'', a flock of squawking birds flies by the [[Warrick family/Legends|Warrick family]] hut. These may have been churis.
